conversation_before_the_call.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I think I might have lost my wallet with both of my debit cards in it. I have two checking accounts with you — my Bluest Account and my Light Green Account. I’ve been looking everywhere and I can’t find my wallet. I’m not 100% sure it’s gone but I’m getting worried about both cards.

{"message":"I’m sorry you’re dealing with this — I can help. Since you’re not sure whether the wallet is truly lost, here are your immediate options and what I recommend:

- Freeze (temporary) — recommended if you’re still looking: this immediately blocks new transactions and recurring payments but can be undone if you find the wallet. Pending authorized transactions may still post.
- Close (permanent) — use if you’re sure the cards are gone or stolen: the cards are permanently deactivated and cannot be reactivated. Pending transactions may still settle; you can order replacements.

Other important items:
- If you report within 2 business days, Regulation E limits your liability to $50 for unauthorized debit card charges (liability grows the longer you wait). So reporting quickly helps protect you.
- We’ll also check if you have any Rho-Bank credit cards and offer replacement cards if they were in the wallet (I can only check that after we verify you).
- If you’re traveling and need access to funds, an emergency replacement may be available faster — tell me if you’re abroad.

To take action (freeze or close cards, check for credit cards, order replacements), I’ll need to verify your identity first. For verification I need you to provide any 2 of the following: date of birth, email on file, phone number on file, or your mailing address. (I won’t ask for full SSN.)

What would you like to do right now?
1) Temporarily freeze both cards (Bluest Account and Light Green Account) — my recommendation if you’re still searching.
2) Permanently close one or both cards and order replacements.
3) Wait and do nothing yet.

If you want me to proceed, tell me which option you choose and which two verification items you’ll provide. If you’d rather speak to a human right away, say so and I’ll transfer you."}
